module_summary: settingsio.cpp is the settings-persistence half split out of opl.cpp: boot-home resolution (resolveBootDirToMass, APA/APA+exFAT hybrid, MMCE, network-deferred, BDM), the config.path Custom Settings Path redirect and its mc mirror, read-only recovery discovery (tryAlternateDevice and helpers), _loadConfig (post-read clamps and legacy migrations for theme, network protocol, POPSTARTER, Neutrino, Ember, RA), _saveConfig with its APA staged-home and custom-path branches, applyConfig and the saveConfig UI wrapper. Load runs once at boot on the IO worker; save runs on the IO worker through guiHandleDeferedIO. autolaunch (opl.cpp miniInit) shares resolveBootDirToMass, tryAlternateDevice, configReadNeutrinoGlobals and configReadRA.

findings.title: Concrete mc0:/mc1: boot handling in preferredMcSlot, tryMissingConfigPathRecovery and the tryAlternateDevice legacy fallback is unreachable
findings.problem: tryAlternateDevice returns at 1012-1019 for every concrete MC boot, so tryMissingConfigPathRecovery (only caller 1023) and the legacy block at 1044-1081 never see gBootDir starting mc0:/mc1:; nothing in between rewrites gBootDir. preferredMcSlot's other caller, mcConfigPathRedirect, is only reached under gBootHomeDeferred (311, 360), which is set only for smb/udpfs boots (1398-1400). So preferredMcSlot always returns sysCheckMC(), the mc1-first swap is dead, and the concreteMcHome branch and the sameConcreteMcSlot(gBootDir, concreteMcHome) branch never run.
findings.fix: Delete preferredMcSlot and call sysCheckMC() in mcConfigPathRedirect; use the fixed {0,1} slot order in tryMissingConfigPathRecovery and drop its stale comment; in the legacy fallback call configSetMove(NULL) directly and delete the concreteMcHome buffer and the sameConcreteMcSlot else-if (keep the gBootHomeDeferred / configSetMove(gBootDir) pair).
findings.benefit: ~30 source lines and a few hundred bytes of live code removed (INFERRED: the branches sit inside reachable functions, so the compiler cannot drop them); the remaining recovery logic reads as what it does.
findings.evidence: Read settingsio.cpp 239-262, 853-931, 938-1121, 1332-1466. Grep gBootHomeDeferred: set only 1338 (reset) and 1400 (smb/udpfs branch). Grep preferredMcSlot: 242, 255, 857 only. Grep for gBootDir writers in src: opl.cpp:2021,2085 (setBootDir/main), settingsio 1232,1301 (APA paths, return before 1012), 1367 (cdrom: empties it), 1445, 2438 (save path). configInit/configSetMove (config.cpp:630,660) do not touch gBootDir. tryAlternateDevice callers: settingsio 1562, 1918, opl.cpp:1894 (after resolveBootDirToMass at 1878). .github/scripts/test_autolaunch_settings.py:403-404 checks the homeLeftOnCard/configPrepareNotifications tail, which the fix keeps.

findings.title: trySaveAlternateDevice: gBootDir copy and the whole host: fast path are dead (only called when gBootDir is empty)
findings.problem: The only caller (2454) is inside if (gBootDir[0] == '\0'), so the gBootDir branch at 2052-2053 never runs, and oplBootDirIsHostFs() (util.cpp:980-985, returns 0 unless gBootDir starts with host) is always false there, so the 11-line host: write-and-return block never runs. A host: boot never reaches this function at all because its gBootDir is non-empty.
findings.fix: Delete the gBootDir branch (use getcwd only) and delete the oplBootDirIsHostFs() branch with its comment, starting the boot-device chain at the hdd/pfs test.
findings.benefit: ~13 source lines removed; small code-size saving (INFERRED, static function body shrinks).
findings.evidence: Grep trySaveAlternateDevice over the repo: definition 2047 and the single call 2454 (no test or other reference). gBootDir is only rewritten in _saveConfig at 2438, under gBootDir[0] != '\0'. oplBootDirIsHostFs read at src/platform/util.cpp:980-985.

findings.title: _loadConfig: lscstatus is always CONFIG_ALL, so the network-only retry is unreachable; dead stores at 1777-1778 and 1976
findings.problem: _loadConfig has one caller (opl.cpp:1719, once at boot) and lscstatus is static-initialised to CONFIG_ALL (0xFF, config.h:21), so if (lscstatus & CONFIG_OPL) is always true and the tryAlternateDevice retry at 1916-1919 (guarded by !(lscstatus & CONFIG_OPL)) can never run; the comment at 1916 admits no caller asks for network alone. gEnableUDPBD/gNetBootProtocol written at 1777-1778 are not read before being rewritten at 1828-1829. lscret = result at 1976 is never read: saveConfig resets lscret to 0 (2559) before any read.
findings.fix: Use CONFIG_ALL directly in _loadConfig instead of lscstatus, drop the always-true CONFIG_OPL test, delete the network-only retry (1912-1919), delete lines 1777-1778 and 1976.
findings.benefit: ~10 source lines removed; no measurable size change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep _loadConfig: definition settingsio 1546, prototype oplint.h:21, call opl.cpp:1719 only. Grep lscstatus: assigned at 81 (CONFIG_ALL), 1977, 2558 (saveConfig) and zeroed in _saveConfig. Grep lscret: read only in _saveConfig and saveConfig after the reset at 2559. Read 1779-1827: uses gNetworkProtocol, gETHStartMode, gNetProtocolPick, gUdpfsAccessMode, gNetStartMode only; NET_PROTO_IS_ETH (opl.h:369) uses only its argument.

findings.title: Copy-paste slot blocks: checkLoadConfigMMCE and trySaveConfigMMCE repeat the mmce0/mmce1 body; writeConfigPathRedirect repeats its write body
findings.problem: checkLoadConfigMMCE has two identical 12-line blocks differing only in "mmce0:" vs "mmce1:", and trySaveConfigMMCE has two identical 6-line blocks the same way. writeConfigPathRedirect writes path plus newline and checks both write counts twice (348-354 and 368-372).
findings.fix: Loop over the two MMCE roots in both functions; fold the two redirect writes into one small static write-path-and-newline function used by both the CWD copy and the mc mirror.
findings.justification: The small write function replaces two identical 5-line bodies, so it removes code overall.
findings.benefit: ~18 source lines removed (INFERRED: 31->17 and 18->12 lines for the MMCE pair, ~4 for the redirect write).
findings.evidence: Read 88-118, 331-385, 1984-2001 side by side; only the device string differs within each MMCE function; the two redirect write bodies are textually identical apart from the variable they assign.

findings.title: About 20 include lines in settingsio.cpp are leftovers of opl.cpp's include list that this file does not use
findings.problem: No identifier from launchdiag.h, guigame.h, textures.h, dia.h, dialogs.h, extern_irx.h, ethsupport.h, udpfssupport.h, appsupport.h, folderbrowse.h, cuesupport.h, rabadge.h, cheatman.h, xparam.h, delaythread.h, fileXio_rpc.h or libds34bt/libds34usb.h appears in the file body; fntsys.h is also pulled in unconditionally by opl.h:46, so its __OPLDIAG include is redundant. Several include comments are false here (62: fileXio 'used by BDM autolaunch'; 46 folderDepth; 50 cueIsCueEntry). The same block appears in opl.cpp, autolaunch.cpp, lwnbdctl.cpp, appscan.cpp, menuitems.cpp (dupes lead, INFERRED same cause).
findings.fix: Delete these include lines (and the NEWLIB_PORT_AWARE define that only serves fileXio_rpc.h), then build both toolchains to confirm nothing relied on them transitively.
findings.benefit: ~25 source lines removed, faster compile of this unit; no ELF change (INFERRED: declarations only).
findings.evidence: Script (scratchpad hdrcheck.py) intersected identifiers in each include/*.h (comments stripped) with identifiers in settingsio.cpp's non-include lines: listed headers share only generic words/types (config_set_t from config.h, field names). Grep settingsio.cpp for fileXio|delayThread|cueIs|folderDepth|cheat|xparam|ds34|_irx: only the include lines. fntsys.h included by opl.h:46 (fntValidFontSize at fntsys.h:24). INFERRED part: transitive needs not compile-checked.

findings.title: Stale and misplaced comments in resolveBootDirToMass (MMCE no-op stub NOTE, detached MMCE paragraph, wrong hdd-branch claim)
findings.problem: 1405-1410 says mmceLoadModules() is still a no-op stub so the poll always times out, but mmceLoadModules calls MmceSupport::loadModules, a real loader (mmcesupport.cpp:733-762). 1373-1376 describes the MMCE branch but sits above the network branch, separated from it. 1383-1386 says the hdd branch blanks gBootDir and re-homes to configInit(NULL); the hdd branch (1348-1361) keeps the launch identity.
findings.fix: Delete the NOTE(rebuild) paragraph and the detached MMCE paragraph; trim 1383-1386 to the cdrom case only.
findings.benefit: ~12 comment lines removed; no binary change.
findings.evidence: Read settingsio.cpp 1332-1466 and src/sources/mmcesupport.cpp:733-762 (loadModules body and mmceLoadModules forwarder).

findings.title: Dotted-quad IP read/write repeated 6x and 5x in _loadConfig/_saveConfig (plus 3x in config.cpp)
findings.problem: Each IP key is read with its own configGetStr + sscanf("%d.%d.%d.%d") pair and written with its own snprintf + configSetStr pair; the same write pair appears three more times in config.cpp's IPCONFIG.DAT import. Only the RA host IP (1531-1540) range-checks the result.
findings.fix: Add one configGetIp(set, key, int[4]) and one configSetIp(set, key, const int[4]) next to configGetStr/configSetStr and use them at every site.
findings.justification: Eleven two-line pairs in settingsio.cpp and three in config.cpp become one-line calls (~14 lines saved) for ~10 lines of helpers, a small net reduction; the getter can also carry the 0-255 check the RA copy already does, at no extra cost per site.
findings.benefit: ~4-6 net source lines and a few hundred bytes of repeated call sequences (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read settingsio.cpp 1921-1959 and 2273-2301; grep '%d.%d.%d.%d' over src: settingsio.cpp 14 matches, config.cpp 4 (752 sscanf, 760-765 snprintf); grep configSetIp|configGetIp|parseIp: no existing helper (only vcdParseIpConfig, a different format).
